_note: Every number the siting model uses. See ASSUMPTIONS.md. Change values here, not in code.

power._note: Indicative MW a new campus could draw from the existing >=230 kV network in the county, by highest line voltage. Rule of thumb: one 230 kV line carries ~200-400 MW, 345 kV ~400-900 MW, 500 kV 1,000+ MW.

water._note: On-site water per kWh of facility energy, by cooling design. Allowance = share of the county's public-supply withdrawals a single campus could take.

32510.where: Carson City, NV (commercial volume charge, Jul 2025)

land._note: Acres a campus needs per MW (buildings, substation, setbacks), and the share of a county's open land realistically available as large parcels.

facility._note_utilization: Average load as a share of the campus's maximum draw.

sources.transmission: HIFLD Electric Power Transmission Lines (>=230 kV), via ArcGIS FeatureServer US_Electric_Power_Transmission_Lines
sources.generation: EIA-860M, September 2026 (operating, planned and retiring generators)
sources.water: USGS Estimated Use of Water in the United States, County-Level Data for 2015 (v2.0)
sources.climate: NOAA nClimDiv county normals 1991-2020: annual precipitation and cooling degree days
sources.population: US Census Bureau county population estimates, July 2024
sources.land: US Census Bureau 2023 cartographic boundary counties (land area)
sources.price: EIA Electric Power Monthly Table 5.6.B, Jan-Aug 2026 YTD
sources.tokens: Wh per 1,000 output tokens by model tier: data/energy_factors.json (from the AI Energy Bill project)
